items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Daisy' in the context of discussing another musician's wife ('his sister's name... that was his wife'). The interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of Daisy herself.

ctx.x: Oh, I can't think of his sister's name offhand. Daisy? No, not Daisy; that was his wife. But whatever. Then did they... Did she ever kind of sign(?) up, or were they just another band up there?
